name: mythos-router
description: Lets agents on any model start subagents on Claude Mythos: two Mythos agent types, optional routing of other subagents, and an optional check for newer Mythos releases. Needs an account with Mythos access.

routing.title: Routing at session start
routing.description: off: only the mythos-router agent types run on Mythos. on: general-purpose agents also do, when the caller names no model. all: every new subagent does. /mythos-subagents changes it for one session.

model.title: Mythos model
model.description: The Mythos model ID subagents run on; autoUpgrade may use a newer one. Only claude-mythos-* IDs are accepted.

autoUpgrade.title: Check for newer Mythos releases
autoUpgrade.description: Once a day at session start, send a short request to the next Mythos model IDs and use the newest that answers instead of the model option.
